name: IC Analog — SPI — MSOP
description: Collection of 8 surface-mount analog IC parts featuring SPI interfaces in MSOP package footprints such as MSOP-8 and MSOP-10.
selection_hints: Selecting surface-mount analog ICs requiring an SPI interface in MSOP packaging.
Filtering parts by specific footprint variants such as MSOP-8_3x3mm_P0.65mm or MSOP-10_3x3mm_P0.5mm.
Selecting parts based on quality tier preferences between Tier A and Tier B.
avoid_when: The design requires non-MSOP package families or through-hole mounting.
The component must support a communication interface other than SPI.
The project requires a non-analog IC component.
